title: A topic created by updateForumTopicInfo is pushed without preserving or fetching its unread and last message state
trigger: A bot creates a topic while the topic list is loaded
effect: The topic shows no unread badge and an empty preview until the driver refetches; topic order is max+1 with unchecked add
fix: Request getForumTopic for a new topic id, and use saturating_add for order.

title: replace_forum_topic runs keep_dirty_topic_drafts before the loaded check and drops the answer when the list is not loaded
trigger: getForumTopic answer arrives before getForumTopics (opening a topic from a link)
effect: The answer is discarded, the topic has no data until the list loads; the draft merge ran on a topic that is then thrown away
fix: Check loaded first, or store the answer in a per-topic Fetch.

title: Answers stamped with a closed chat window land in a new window for the same chat
trigger: Open chat X in its own window, start a view request there (shared media, calendar, message-by-date, thread history, sponsored rows), close the window and reopen X in a window before the answer lands.
effect: PendingRequest::window is the chat id, which repeats: apply_payload_in_asking_view finds window_chats contains X again and applies the old window's answer to the new window's fresh view. Most view states have their own stamp, but any that match only by chat (sponsored rows, date jump, Instant View) take it.
fix: Key window views by a per-open window token (or bump a view epoch in open_window_chat) and stamp requests with it, so a reopened window never takes the closed one's answers.

title: Log out from the Account box leaves the typed 2FA password and reason in the box's text fields
trigger: Settings > Account: type the 2FA password (or a reason) in the delete-account section, then press Log out > Log out.
effect: submit_logout clears only confirm_logout and open; the shell then closes the kit dialog with window.close_dialog, which does not run on_close, so close_account_lifecycle (which empties reason and password) never runs. The password stays in the TextareaState until the screen is replaced, against the A2 rule the box documents.
fix: Have submit_logout go through close_account_lifecycle, or make the box's open state an enum whose leaving drops the inputs (Option<LifecycleBox { reason, password, confirm }>).

title: recovery_mode is set when the recovery request is sent, before the server accepts it
trigger: On the 2FA password step press Forgot password? and the server refuses (too many requests).
effect: The screen switches to recovery-code entry and says the code was sent. The error arrives later as last_auth_error; the user waits for an email that never comes (Resend and Back are the only ways out).
fix: Make the password step an enum PasswordStep { Password, RecoveryRequested { request }, RecoveryCode } and move to RecoveryCode on the answer.

title: Terms prompt state outlives the terms it was about
trigger: Tick the age box and Agree (or leave the prompt at DeclineSorry or DeleteWarning by closing it some other way). A later terms update arrives in the same session.
effect: terms_age_ok stays true and terms_step stays where it was, so the new terms open with the age already confirmed (or on the sorry/delete step) and Agree skips the age check.
fix: Own the prompt state in an Option created when notices.terms becomes Some and dropped when it becomes None.

title: Terms box step and age checkbox are never reset, so a later terms prompt opens pre-ticked or on the Decline step
trigger: Tick 'I confirm that I am N or older' and Agree (or go to Decline > Back is not pressed, e.g. Decline then the terms are cleared); later in the same run TDLib sends a new updateTermsOfService.
effect: AuthUi::terms_age_ok stays true and terms_step keeps its old value (only AuthUi::new sets them): the new terms show the age box already ticked, or open on the 'sorry'/delete warning step.
fix: Keep the box's step and age answer in one `TermsBox { terms_id, step, age_ok }` value created when a terms id first shows, so a new id starts a fresh value.

title: Network usage reset confirmation stays armed after leaving the Data and Storage page
trigger: Data and Storage, press 'Reset statistics' (confirm shown), go to another settings page, return via the sidebar.
effect: The page shows 'Reset the statistics?' with a live Reset button again; network_reset_confirm is cleared only by open_data_storage, not by leave_data_storage/arrive_data_storage (data_storage.rs:218-231).
fix: Make the confirm part of the page's transient state dropped in leave_data_storage (an enum NetworkReset { Idle, Confirming } on the settings page state).

title: Failed reset of network statistics is silent
trigger: Press Reset in the confirmation while the driver cannot send (chats path inactive or send error).
effect: The confirm disappears as if the reset worked; reset_network_statistics (connect/privacy_data.rs:199-213) returns Err without setting any error and the UI discards it with let _.
fix: Surface the Err as data_storage_error (the pattern of clear_storage/set_storage_limits) and keep the confirm until the send succeeded.

title: Auto-download editor closes on Save before TDLib confirms; a refused save drops the draft
trigger: Edit a network's auto-download caps, press Save, TDLib answers with an error.
effect: The editor was taken at Save (only a failed send restores it); on a TDLib error the overview shows the error line and the user's draft is gone.
fix: enum Editor { Closed, Open{network,draft}, Saving{network,draft,request} } restored to Open on the matching error answer.

title: The invisible Waiting step drains only in the window that asked; a minimized asking chat window strands it
trigger: In a chat window's header press 'Start video chat' and minimize that window before getVideoChatAvailableParticipants answers.
effect: CreateStep::Waiting is not drawn (is_open false) and its answer is applied only by the asking window's frame upkeep; with that window not drawing, nothing shows and no feedback until the window comes back. Pressing Start again replaces the flow, so it recovers.
fix: Apply the join-as answer in the session-wide poll (matched by the RequestId already in Waiting) and only open the box in the asking window.

title: Schedule box keeps its 'out of range' error after a valid time is picked
trigger: Open 'Schedule video chat', pick a time less than the minimum ahead, press Schedule (error shows), then pick a valid time.
effect: ScheduleStep::error is cleared only by the next Schedule press; the red error stays under a valid pick.
fix: Derive the error from the picked value at render (check_schedule) instead of storing it, or clear it on picker change.

title: Starting a video chat leaves the current call before the create request is sent
trigger: In a video chat, start another one in a different chat and confirm the leave box while createVideoChat cannot be sent (driver Err, e.g. connection closed).
effect: send_group_call_create calls end_current_call_for_create first, then start_video_chat().ok(); on Err the user only gets a server-error toast and is out of their original call with no new one. Same order in start_rtmp_stream_now (rtmp_stream.rs:363-373).
fix: Send first and end the old call from the accepted-request path (or when the new call is tracked), a CreateStep::Sending(RequestId) carrying the intent.

title: 'Clear selected' forgets the ticked types even when the clear was refused
trigger: Tick types, confirm Clear while storage_clearing is true or the send fails.
effect: storage_selected is cleared before clear_storage runs; its Err (let _) leaves an error line but the ticks are lost.
fix: Clear the selection only on the confirmed answer (or when the send returned Ok).

title: Typing on the lock screen erases the flood-wait message while the button stays disabled
trigger: Enter a wrong passcode until Too many tries appears, then type in the field.
effect: Change takes lock_error, so the message goes while flood_until still disables Unlock; the screen shows a dead button with no reason until the countdown ends.
fix: LockScreenError enum { None, Wrong(text), Flood{until} }; typing clears only Wrong.

title: Lock leaves the media panel on its GIFs tab, so the GIF gate stays open under the lock
trigger: Open the GIFs tab of the composer panel, lock Quill with the passcode.
effect: close_for_lock never closes the media panel; the panel is only hidden, so wanted stays true and gifs.open stays set; the GIF search/download work continues while locked.
fix: Derive the GIF gate from what is drawn (not locked and panel on Gifs), or close the gate in close_for_lock.

title: Lock-screen Log out while a system unlock prompt is pending is later undone by the prompt's answer
trigger: Press Touch ID / system unlock, and while the OS prompt is open confirm Log out.
effect: The wipe starts and the lock lifts, then the prompt answers ok: global_unlock().set(master) and unlock_done run again for wiped accounts (second resume_after_unlock, intents, connection start).
fix: Log out sets PasscodeJob::Cancelled (or drops the receiver wait) so system_unlock_wait ignores a late answer.

title: Auto-lock and Touch ID switches show a new value even when saving it failed
trigger: Turn Touch ID on or pick an auto-lock time while passcode.json cannot be written.
effect: set_autolock_secs and set_system_unlock discard the write error; the UI shows the new setting, the next start uses the old one.
fix: Apply the setting to the UI state only after the write returns Ok, and show an error otherwise.

title: QR card draws another link's code when the new code is not ready or failed
trigger: In your own box reset the free code or let a temporary link expire so the link changes.
effect: qr_code_image falls back to the newest ready code of any link when the wanted key is Loading or Failed, so a Failed slot keeps the previous link's code on the card while Copy/Share use the new link.
fix: Return None for a Failed slot (draw no code) and fall back only while the wanted key is Loading.

title: Copy does nothing, with no toast, when the box changed during the render
trigger: On macOS or Windows press Copy, then pick another color before the image finishes.
effect: The continuation computes current = same_box && qr_image_current(..); when the appearance differs it returns false without a toast and done ignores the PNG, so the click is lost.
fix: Re-run the export for the new appearance, or toast 'try again'.

title: Pending share card file leaks when the screen is replaced before the chat opens
trigger: In the QR box press Share, pick a chat, then switch account (or lose the link's chat open) before the chat opens.
effect: qr_share_chosen closes the box and parks (ChatId, PNG path) in pending_attach. PeerQrUi's Farewell closes only an open box, so the OnScreen swap drops pending_attach and the temp PNG is never removed.
fix: Make Farewell call drop_shared_card too (or give the card file a guard type that deletes on drop).

title: Any share chooser's pick or cancel closes or strips an open QR box
trigger: Open a QR box in the main window, then in a chat window use a group link row's Share and pick a chat (or cancel).
effect: choose_share_chat and cancel_share_link call qr_share_chosen/qr_share_cancelled unconditionally; qr_share_chosen closes whichever QR box is open and qr_share_cancelled deletes its share_image, although the chooser was not opened by it.
fix: Remember in the box which chooser it opened (enum Share { None, Chooser{window} }) and act only for that one.

title: The 2FA dialog's build closure changes twofa.view and confirm while rendering
trigger: A Recover/LoginEmail step finishes (twofa_step_finished) while the box is open.
effect: build_twofa_dialog writes this.twofa.view = Status and confirm = None during the draw without notifying or clearing the flow's input fields and notice; the state changes in the middle of a frame, other parts of the same frame (footer, notice) were already built from the old view.
fix: Move the step to the place the answer is applied (session apply hook) via goto_twofa_view, and keep render pure.

title: sessions_layer_open reads session_details while the dialog is open only when details_session() resolves
trigger: Open a session's box, terminate that session from another device so it leaves the list
effect: The box closes (is_open false) but session_details and renaming_device stay set, so the first Esc on the Devices page is swallowed closing an invisible layer
fix: Drop session_details when its session leaves the list, or derive sessions_layer_open from details_session().

title: The PIN asked for one key is tried on every plugged-in key in turn
trigger: Plug in two FIDO2 keys with different PINs, sign in with a passkey that lives on the second key, enter its PIN.
effect: run_login asks for the PIN when key B says PIN_REQUIRED, then the next round starts again at key A with B's PIN; A answers PIN_INVALID, the user is told 'Incorrect PIN' and A's retry counter drops (eventually blocking A). The PIN is not matched to the key that asked.
fix: Carry the key that asked for the PIN (device path/index) with the PIN and try it only on that key in the next attempt.

title: A security key Quill may not open (no udev rule) reads as 'no key' after the whole timeout
trigger: On Linux without the u2f udev rule, plug in a security key and choose 'Use a security key' / start a passkey ceremony.
effect: open_all logs 'cannot open /dev/hidrawN' every 500 ms poll and returns nothing; Link::devices waits until the request deadline (60 s) and the dialog then says no security key was found, never that access was denied.
fix: Return the open error from open_all (an enum Found { Keys(..), Denied(path) }) and end the ceremony with a permission error the dialog can show.
